name: Bountyfly - The downpour
source:
Play as a human on a distant planet, trying to get out of a sticky situation when they run into an interesting... "Opportunity". This opportunity? A generous and kind bartender willing to help you out, in more ways than one~ Upgrade your stats and skills to deal with situations in a classical RPG manner, earn more skill points by completing a chapter and having successful interactions. Once you finish the chapter, unlock "free play" with infinite stats!

[From [url=https://doriam.itch.io/downpour]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名身处遥远星球的人类，正努力摆脱眼前的困境，却遇上一个有趣的……“机会”。这个机会是什么？一位慷慨善良的酒保愿意帮助你，而且不只是在一种意义上哦～

升级属性与技能，以传统角色扮演游戏的方式应对各种状况；完成章节并成功互动，还能获得更多技能点。通关章节后，即可解锁属性无限的“自由游玩”模式！

[来源：[url=https://doriam.itch.io/downpour]Itch.io[/url]]
